facets.medium: 手工纸拼贴纸景 · 微缩人物

source.from: Original technique specification; inspiration: handmade-paper landscape posters
source.notes: 2026-11 参考公众号文章《我如何用AI，做出这种超绝的东方美学海报》中的两类东方海报做法，仅取思路，配方自写；未复制文章或第三方 Skill（chinese-poster-skill、fantasy-dongfang-jianyuehaibao）的文本与图片。

essence: 大片薄手工纸拼出山、园、花、灯等大形，纸片本身构成景物
长纤维、纸浆碎屑、薄撕裂边，层叠阴影极轻
大形与微缩人物场景形成强烈尺度对比

recipe.positive: Flat handmade-paper collage poster on an opaque warm ivory paper ground. Large sheets of thin translucent handmade paper are torn and layered so that the paper shapes themselves form the scenery — mountains, a garden enclosure, petals, a lantern or a fan — in a few broad, unbroken colour planes with front, middle and back layers. The paper shows clear long natural fibres, tiny pulp flecks and occasional plant fragments; edges are thin, irregular torn deckles; where sheets overlap there is only the faintest shadow, no thickness. Somewhere in the open space a tiny, finely drawn flat miniature scene — a few small people doing one quiet everyday or craft activity with a few props — gives a dramatic contrast of scale with the huge paper forms. Even, bright, soft light; light and airy; restrained harmonious colours. Not a photograph with paper texture laid over it, not thick cardboard, not a 3D paper sculpture, no tape, no halftone dots, no vignette, no yellowed ageing.
recipe.text_style: Use only the requested exact text. Lettering is a slim, light Song-style serif in black or dark grey with loose spacing, small and restrained so it never becomes the main visual; never bold, never gold. No invented captions, seals or pseudo-text.

composition.negative_space: 40–50% of the canvas, broad and continuous
composition.figure_scale: each person about 1/25 to 1/28 of the canvas height; the whole group with its props no wider than 30% and no taller than 11% of the canvas; no facial close-up
composition.big_shape: one or two huge paper forms enter from a corner, built from a few large complete colour planes, never confetti-like fragments

type.face: slim light Song-style serif, black or dark grey, loose spacing

must_see: 薄手工纸的纤维与撕裂边，纸片本身构成景物
微缩人物场景与大纸形的强烈尺度对比
大片连贯留白，层叠阴影极轻
must_not_see: 实景照片叠纸纹、厚纸板或立体纸雕
胶带、半色调网点、零碎花叶铺满
人物画成大插画、塑料高光、做旧暗角、写实地标建筑
fix_phrases: 保留纸形、配色和标题位置，只把下方人物与器具整组缩小，让周围留白更多
纸材改成薄手工纸，看得见长纤维和撕裂边，去掉厚度和重阴影
大纸形合并成几块完整的大色块，去掉零碎的小纸片
